name: Cloudflare Pages
line: Build and host static sites with optional edge Functions.

free.text: Static delivery unlimited; Functions share 100,000 daily requests

work.math: Static-only subtotal. Assumes up to 20,000 files, each up to 25 MiB, and builds within the Free plan limit. Whether commercial use is allowed is unclear.
The 256 MiB of memory the workload needs is more than the 128 MB limit for each isolate (a separate running copy of the code).
Same memory limit problem as the small app API. D1 is not the required Postgres database.
